message.content:
This document describes **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine that runs very large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models on consumer and prosumer hardware by tiering experts across VRAM, RAM, and NVMe SSD. Key technical points:

**Models supported**
- **GLM-5.3-Flash** (zai-org, MIT): 321B params, ~18B active/token, 1M context, 45 layers (3 dense + 42 MoE with 288 routed experts, top-8), 34 KDA linear-attention + 11 DSA/MLA
